RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the May 8, 2007/Vaisakha 18, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Culture; Finance;
Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
145
Promotion of SCs in Customs
Department, Patna
†*461. PROF. RAM DEO
BHANDARY: W ill the Minister of
FINANCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Customs
Commissioner in additional/dual charge,
Patna has performed illegal action by
depriving the Group-C employees of
Scheduled Castes of thier due promotion
to the post of Inspectors; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Failure of RBI in controlling inflation
*462. SHRI S.M. LALJAN
BASHA:
SHRI M.V. MYSURA
REDDY:
Will the Minister of FINANCE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether RBI has reported that the
Scheduled Banks business in the country
in 2006-07 upto March 2 grew by
22.5 per cent as compared with 23.4 per
cent growth last year;
(b) if so,whether Government will
explain why inflation continued at over 6.4
per cent in the month of March, 2007
despite claims of RBI that liquidity is less;
(c) whether it is a fact that RBI has
either been unable or perhaps unwilling to
bring down inflation to less than 2.5 per
cent; and
(d) if so,what steps  Government will
take to introduce fiscal measures to counter
the non activity of RBI?
Adequate infrastructural facilities to
attract FDI
*463. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: W ill the Minister of
FINANCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are providing
adequate infrastructural facilities to the
companies to attract more FDI;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

146
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last three years;
(c) whether Government have identified
some countries in their list to attract more
FDI;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the developmental projects
undertaken with this amount during the last
three years especially in Andhra Pradesh?
Dependence on oil imports
*464. SHRI DARA SINGH: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India is the
third largest oil consuming country in Asia
and imports 70 per cent of its crude to
meet its energy needs;
(b) if so, what steps the Ministry has
so far taken to tap more domestic reservoirs
to help offset its growing dependence on
imports alongwith details thereof; and
(c) the budgetary allocations made
during the year 2007-08 in comparison to
the year 2006-07 to meet India's energy
needs?
Extension of ethanol-blended petrol
programme
*465. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have proposed
to extend ethanol-blended petrol
programme to every part of the country;
(b) if so, the number of States in which
the programme is presently operational and
the number of States where the extension
of ethanol-blended petrol programme is
planned; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Cooperation with Russia in energy
sector
*466. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have signed
an agreement with Russia on cooperation
in energy sector during the recent visit of
the President of Russia;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have made an
assessment of the commercial benefits to
India of such an agreement; and
(d) whether such agreements enhance
the energy security of the country?
Promotion of tourism in North-
Eastern States
*467. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of TOURISM  be pleased to state:
(a) the schemes sanctioned by
Government to promote tourism in North-
Eastern States specially in Sikkim;
(b) the assistance provided by
Government to these State Governments
during each of the last three years alongwith
the amount spent by these State
Governments for the purpose; and
(c) the steps taken in that regard during
the Ninth Plan and proposed for the Tenth
Plan?

147
Compassionate appointment to
dependents of deceased employees in
banks
*468. SHRI K.E. ISMAIL: Will the
Minister of FINANCE  be pleased to state:
(a) how many employees have died in
harness in different Public Sector Banks
during the last three years;
(b) out of these cases, how many
dependents of the deceased have been given
compassionate appointment;
(c) whether it is a fact that the Public
Sector Banks have stopped recruitment on
compassionate grounds; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor?
Pay revision of PSU employees
*469. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES
AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased
to state:
(a) the approximate number of
employees working in the various Public
Sector Enterprises/Undertakings in the
country;
(b) whether Government have set up a
Committee for the pay revision of PSU
employees;
(c) if so, the details thereof;

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for  WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the May 8, 2007/Vaisakha 18, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Culture; Finance; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 155
812
Modernization of non-metro airports
3502. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to modernize the clusters of non-metro
airports through private companies;
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the names of the airports which are
proposed to be modernized; and
(c) what are the names of companies
which have been short-listed for this
purpose, including the details of the bids
offered by each?
Expansion and modernization of
airports in Tamil Nadu
3503. SHRI B.S. GNANADESIKAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Tamil Nadu had requested the Ministry to
expand airports at Coimbatore, Trichy,
Madurai and Tuticorin and also requested
for modernization of Madurai and Trichy
airports;
(b) if so, the steps taken by the
Ministry in this regard;
(c) whether speedy action will be taken
to expand and modernize the Madurai
airport with international connectivity; and
(d) if so, the time-frame by which the
said modernization will take place?
Modernization of ATC system
3504. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
modernize air traffic control system and
build safety standards with the assistance
of USA;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether this would enhance
navigation in all phases of flight, make
routing more flexible and efficient, increase
safety of landing, etc.; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Bird-hit cases at IGIA
3505. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a number of cases of 'bird
hit' and 'Nilgai' on runways at the Indira

813
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Gandhi International Airport have been
reported during the last two years and the
amount of losses incurred; and
(b) if so, the details of steps taken to
check such menace?
Modernization of Patna Airport
†3506. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
increase the number of flights from Delhi
and other places to Patna;
(b) whether Government are working
on a plan to augment the capacity of Patna
Airport and to modernize it;
(c) if so, by when the said work will be
completed;
(d) whether there is a plan to benefit
Bihar also with the recent spurt in aviation
sector; and
(e) if so, in what way and by when?
Wage revision for Air India
Engineers
3507. SHRI R. SHUNMUGASUNDA-
RAM: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether there are demands for wage
revision by Unions of Air India Engineers
and if so, what their demands are;
(b) the steps taken to resolve the issues
on wage revision; and
(c) whether the delay in resolving the
wage revision demands has contributed to
the falling maintenance practices in the
carrier?
Ageing Aircrafts in Air India
3508. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Air India has
majority of ageing planes in its fleet causing
frequent snags in the air;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of planes that have been
grounded in the last three years;
(d) whether it is a fact that Government
are contemplating to purchase new planes
in its fleet; and
(e) if so, the number and make of the
crafts and the time-frame of their
procurement?
Congestion at the airports
3509. SHRIMA TI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that domestic
airlines have increased manifold during the
last three years;
(b) if so, the details thereof, airlines-
wise;
(c) whether it is also a fact that incidents
of air-miss are increasing significantly on
account of number of airlines and aircrafts
increasing much faster than that of adequate
equipment and staff; and
(d) if so, the steps Government have
taken to cope with congestion caused by
aircrafts?

814
Engaging of private caterers by I.A.
3510. SHRI BASHISTHA NARAIN
SINGH: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian Airlines engages
private caterers for on-board meal in their
flights;
(b) if so, the names of caterers engaged
in Srinagar-Delhi sector during the years,
2006 and 2007, indicating their allocations
of work; and
(c) what was the summer schedule of
catering in the year, 2006 in the above sector
and whether the same has been changed in
the year, 2007?
Aged aircrafts operating in the
country

to state:
(a) the number of aircr
